title: PET-184 in-flight dispatch marker
description: raw/inflight/<stem-leaf>.json. Written before launch with pid/startTime null, rewritten after launch with the real identity, deleted on every terminal path. This file is the single authority for the marker's field set; the spec references it and does not restate it.

stem.description: Full stem path. Every consumer resolves artifacts from this; the filename is never parsed.

area.description: 1-5, 6a, 6b, 6c, sweep, smoke, or a PETRT-nnn finding id.

units.description: The bullets or parts this dispatch actually carries, enumerated. NOT the literal 'all' -- that is a stem token only. attempts.json charges every key in this list.

expected_units.description: Decision 4 rule 5's denominator. Equals units.length; recorded so the rule has a persisted home.

pid.description: codex: the child's PID. http: the launching shell's $PID, so the poller has a kill target. null only in the pre-launch write.

startTime.description: ISO 8601 round-trip ('o'). null only in the pre-launch write.
